title: Subsidiaries without Public Accountability: Disclosures
summary: Specifies reduced disclosure requirements for eligible subsidiaries without public accountability, replacing the disclosure requirements of other IFRS Accounting Standards.

bannerNotice.title: New Standard — Effective 1 January 2027 (Voluntary)
bannerNotice.body: IFRS 19 was issued in May 2024 and amended in August 2025. It becomes voluntarily available for annual periods beginning on or after 1 January 2027, with early adoption permitted.
